name: calendar.list_upcoming
precondition: days is a positive integer (default 7); if using a calendar API, credentials must be configured (GOOGLE_CALENDAR_TOKEN env var or pass entry at friday/calendar).
postcondition: Returns structural metadata of events starting within the next 'days' days from now. Makes NO state changes - events are only read. Sorted by start time, soonest first.
failure_mode: PrimitiveError on API/auth failure or network error - DISTINCT from 'no upcoming events', which returns an empty list. PreconditionError for invalid days parameter (non-positive or non-integer).
returns: list[dict]: [{event_id, summary, start_time, end_time, location, attendees_count}] most recent first. Each dict contains ISO 8601 datetime strings for start_time and end_time.
